description:
booboooking is a booking app. As a provider you can set up your account within a minute at https://booboooking.com and get started with new customers.  

DEMO site: 
https://booboooking.com/booboooking.demo

As a customer, you can configure your AI agent once and then book appointments simply by asking in prompts.
